Captain '''Tolto''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] near [[Kaas City]] [[Dromund Kaas spaceport|Spaceport]] when a traveler came and delivered [[Kullin]]'s report about the Imperial outpost at the entrance of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] jungle.
